roles_en: Minister of the Republic of Armenia
bio_en: Arshak Jamalian (born Isahakian) was born in Ganja in 1882, entered the Gevorgian seminary in 1897 and left it in 1902 as a convinced Dashnak; in 1903 he spent seven months in the Ganja prison. From 1905 he studied social sciences at Berlin University and wrote on social and economic questions under the pen-name Arisian; one of his manuscripts was used against the party in the 1912 ARF trial. A brilliant speaker, editor and organiser, he held leading posts in the party and served as a minister of the Republic of Armenia. He died in Paris on 27 December 1940.
